aether_slash.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
aether_slash.text_zh: 当以太斩击攻击时，若你为使用此牌资源过一张“非攻击”行动牌，对任意目标造成1点奥术伤害。
aether_slash.text_en: When Aether Slash attacks, if a 'non-attack' action card was pitched to play it, deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

amplify_the_arknight.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
amplify_the_arknight.text_zh: 每当你控制一个符文吟唱，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
amplify_the_arknight.text_en: This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.

annals_of_sutcliffe.type_zh: 符文剑士 武器·Book （双手）
annals_of_sutcliffe.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：抽一张牌。若以此方式资源过一张攻击行动牌和一张“非攻击”行动牌，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
annals_of_sutcliffe.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Draw a card. If an attack action card and a 'non-attack' action card were pitched this way, create a Runechant token.

arc_lightning.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动
arc_lightning.text_zh:
欧若拉专精
本回合每当你获得再动时，对任意目标造成1点奥术伤害。
本回合你使用的下一张行动牌获得再动。
再动
arc_lightning.text_en:
Aurora Specialization
Whenever you go again this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to any target.
The next action card you play this turn gets go again.
Go again

arcane_cussing.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
arcane_cussing.text_zh:
再动
当你造成或受到伤害时，摧毁此牌。
当此牌在你的回合期间离开竞技场时，创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。
arcane_cussing.text_en:
Go again
When you deal or are dealt damage, destroy this.
When this leaves the arena during your turn, create 3 Runechant tokens.

arcane_seeds_life.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·大地 瞬间
arcane_seeds_life.text_zh:
凝合
创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
再动
//
获得1点生命。

arcanic_crackle.text_zh: 对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
arcanic_crackle.text_en: Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

arcanic_cunning.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
arcanic_cunning.text_zh: 当此牌正在攻击、防御或在堆叠上时，若你将受到奥术伤害，防止其中1点伤害。
arcanic_cunning.text_en: While this is attacking, defending, or on the stack, if you would be dealt arcane damage, prevent 1 of that damage.

arcanic_reproach.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 瞬间·光环
arcanic_reproach.text_zh:
每位对手英雄每回合第一次对你造成伤害时，你可以展示你手牌中的一张闪电牌。若如此做，对其造成1点奥术伤害。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁你控制的一个光环。
arcanic_reproach.text_en:
The first time an opposing hero deals damage to you each turn, you may reveal a Lightning card from your hand. If you do, deal 1 arcane damage to them.
At the start of your action phase, destroy an aura you control.

arcanic_shockwave.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
arcanic_shockwave.text_zh:
闪电融合
当你用奥术冲击波攻击时，若它已融合，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
arcanic_shockwave.text_en:
Lightning Fusion
When you attack with Arcanic Shockwave, if it was fused, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

arcanic_spike.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
arcanic_spike.text_zh: 若本回合你造成过奥术伤害，此牌获得+2力量。
arcanic_spike.text_en: If you've dealt arcane damage this turn, this gets +2{p}.

arknight_ascendancy.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
arknight_ascendancy.text_zh:
维塞莱专精
每当你控制一个符文吟唱，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
当此牌命中时，创造与此方式造成的伤害数量相等的符文吟唱衍生物。
支配
arknight_ascendancy.text_en:
Viserai Specialization
This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.
When this hits, create Runechant tokens equal to the damage dealt this way.
Dominate

arknight_shard.type_zh: 符文剑士 资源·宝石
arknight_shard.text_zh:
传奇维塞莱专精
当你将大骑士碎片资源时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
arknight_shard.text_en:
Legendary Viserai Specialization
When you pitch Arknight Shard, create a Runechant token.

become_the_arknight.text_zh:
维塞莱专精
你可以弃一张行动牌。若以此方式弃的是攻击行动牌，从你的牌库中搜寻一张符文剑士非攻击行动牌，展示它并将其置入你的手牌。若以此方式弃的是非攻击行动牌，从你的牌库中搜寻一张符文剑士攻击行动牌，展示它并将其置入你的手牌。然后洗牌。再动
become_the_arknight.text_en:
Viserai Specialization
You may discard an action card. If you discard an attack action card this way, search your deck for a Runeblade non-attack action card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you discard a non-attack action card this way, search your deck for a Runeblade attack action card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle. Go again

become_the_shadow_lord.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动
become_the_shadow_lord.text_en:
Banish a card from your hand. If it's Runeblade, create a Runechant token. If it's Shadow, create a Gate to i'Arathael token.
Go again

bequest_the_vast_beyond.text_zh:
维塞莱专精
每当你控制一个符文吟唱，本回合你使用的下一张符文剑士攻击行动牌使用费用减少1点资源。
再动
bequest_the_vast_beyond.text_en:
Viserai Specialization
The next Runeblade attack action card you play this turn costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.
Go again

blessing_of_occult.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
blessing_of_occult.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁神秘祝福，然后创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。
blessing_of_occult.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy Blessing of Occult then create 3 Runechant tokens.

bloodspill_invocation.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
bloodspill_invocation.text_zh:
再动
当你控制的攻击行动牌命中时，摧毁溅血祷文，然后创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。
当你的英雄受到伤害时，摧毁溅血祷文。
bloodspill_invocation.text_en:
Go again
When an attack action card you control hits, destroy Bloodspill Invocation then create 3 Runechant tokens.
When your hero is dealt damage, destroy Bloodspill Invocation.

blossoming_spellblade.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
blossoming_spellblade.text_zh:
大地与闪电融合
若绽放的咒刃已融合，它获得“每当此牌对对手英雄造成伤害时，你可以放逐你坟场中的一张“非攻击”行动牌。若如此做，本回合你可以将它当作瞬间使用，且若本回合它将置入你的坟场，改为放逐它。”
当你用绽放的咒刃攻击时，若它已融合，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
blossoming_spellblade.text_en:
Earth and Lightning Fusion
If Blossoming Spellblade was fused, it gains "Whenever this deals damage to an opposing hero, you may banish a 'non-attack' action card from your graveyard. If you do, you may play it this turn as though it were an instant and if it would be put into your graveyard this turn, instead banish it."
When you attack with Blossoming Spellblade, if it was fused, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

bounding_demigon.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
bounding_demigon.text_zh:
若本回合你使用过一张“非攻击”行动牌，你可以从你的放逐区使用跃动半神。若如此做，它获得+1力量。
血债
bounding_demigon.text_en:
If you have played a 'non-attack' action card this turn, you may play Bounding Demigon from your banished zone. If you do, it gains +1{p}.
Blood Debt

bramble_spark.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动
bramble_spark.text_zh:
大地融合
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得“当你用此牌攻击时，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。”
若荆棘火花已融合，本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
bramble_spark.text_en:
Earth Fusion
The next attack action card you play this turn gains "When you attack with this, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero."
If Bramble Spark was fused, the next attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

burn_up_shock.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·闪电 瞬间
burn_up_shock.text_zh:
凝合
本回合你控制的攻击下一次命中英雄时，对其造成4点奥术伤害。
再动
//
对任意目标造成1点奥术伤害。
burn_up_shock.text_en:
Meld
The next time an attack you control hits a hero this turn, deal 4 arcane damage to them.
Go again
//
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

caress_of_the_reaper.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
caress_of_the_reaper.text_zh: 每当此牌对英雄造成伤害时，摧毁其控制的目标光环。
caress_of_the_reaper.text_en: Whenever this deals damage to a hero, destroy target aura they control.

chorus_of_rotwood.type_zh: 大地 符文剑士 行动
chorus_of_rotwood.text_zh:
分解——你可以放逐你坟场中的2张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。
chorus_of_rotwood.text_en:
Decompose - You may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Create 3 Runechant tokens.

condemn_to_slaughter.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次符文剑士攻击获得+3力量。
你可以摧毁你控制的一个光环。若如此做，每位对手摧毁其控制的一个光环永久物。
再动
condemn_to_slaughter.text_en:
Your next Runeblade attack this turn gets +3{p}.
You may destroy an aura you control. If you do, each opponent destroys an aura permanent they control.
Go again

consuming_volition.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
consuming_volition.text_zh: 若本回合你造成过奥术伤害，此牌获得“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄弃一张牌。”
consuming_volition.text_en: If you've dealt arcane damage this turn, this gets "When this hits a hero, they discard a card."

crackling.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
crackling.text_zh: 闪电流转——若本回合你使用过一张闪电牌，此牌获得+1力量。
crackling.text_en: Lightning Flow - If you've played a Lightning card this turn, this gets +1{p}.

cryptic_crossing.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
cryptic_crossing.text_zh: 若你为使用神秘交叉资源过一张攻击行动牌和一张“非攻击”行动牌，它获得“此牌第一次对防御英雄造成伤害时，该英雄弃一张牌，你抽一张牌。”
cryptic_crossing.text_en: If an attack action card and a 'non-attack' action card were pitched to play Cryptic Crossing, it has "The first time this deals damage to the defending hero, they discard a card and you draw a card."

cull.type_zh: 暗影, 符文剑士, 行动
cull.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用此牌。
若本回合有英雄失去过生命，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
每位英雄放逐其手牌中的一张牌。
血债
cull.text_en:
You may play this from your banished zone.
If a hero has lost {h} this turn, you may play this as thought it were an instant.
Each hero banishes a card from their hand.
Blood Debt

dashing_flashfoot.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
dashing_flashfoot.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点奥术伤害。”
此牌第一次对英雄造成伤害时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
dashing_flashfoot.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p} and "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a hero, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

deadwood_dirge.text_zh:
摧毁你控制的一个光环。若如此做，创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。
再动
deadwood_dirge.text_en:
Destroy an aura you control. If you do, create 3 Runechant tokens.
Go again

deathly_delight.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deathly_delight.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，获得与本回合失去过生命的英雄数量相等的生命。
血债
deathly_delight.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, gain {h} equal to the number of heroes who have lost {h} this turn.
Blood Debt

deathly_duet.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deathly_duet.text_zh: 当死亡二重奏攻击时，若你为使用此牌资源过一张攻击行动牌，它获得+2力量。若你为使用此牌资源过一张“非攻击”行动牌，创造2个符文吟唱衍生物。
deathly_duet.text_en: When Deathly Duet attacks, if an attack action card was pitched to play it, it gains +2{p}. If a 'non-attack' action card was pitched to play it, create 2 Runechant tokens.

deathly_wail.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deathly_wail.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，创造与本回合失去过生命的英雄数量相等的符文吟唱衍生物。
血债
deathly_wail.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, create Runechant tokens equal to the number of heroes who have lost {h} this turn.
Blood Debt

deep_recesses_of_existence.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deep_recesses_of_existence.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，你可以牌面朝下放逐此牌。若如此做，为本回合失去过生命的每位英雄，从他们的坟场中放逐一张牌。
血债
deep_recesses_of_existence.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, you may banish this face-down. If you do, for each hero who has lost {h} this turn, banish a card from their graveyard.
Blood Debt

demonbound_gloomblade.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
demonbound_gloomblade.text_en:
You may play this from your banished zone.
Usurp
Blood Debt

deny_redemption.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deny_redemption.text_zh:
当此牌攻击生命比你高的英雄时，对其造成1点奥术伤害。该伤害不能被防止。
瞬间——弃掉此牌：本回合英雄不能获得生命。
deny_redemption.text_en:
When this attacks a hero with more {h} than you, deal 1 arcane damage to them. This damage can't be prevented.
Instant - Discard this: Heroes can't gain {h} this turn.

destructive_fleetfoot.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
destructive_fleetfoot.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个光环衍生物。
destructive_fleetfoot.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, destroy an aura token they control.

diabolic_ultimatum.text_zh:
若你为使用恶魔最后通牒资源过一张攻击行动牌，每位英雄选择并摧毁其控制的一个盟友。
若你为使用恶魔最后通牒资源过一张“非攻击”行动牌，每位英雄选择并摧毁其控制的一个光环。
diabolic_ultimatum.text_en:
If an attack action card was pitched to play Diabolic Ultimatum, each hero chooses and destroys an ally they control.
If a 'non-attack' action card was pitched to play Diabolic Ultimatum, each hero chooses and destroys an aura they control.

dimenxxional_crossroads.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·光环
dimenxxional_crossroads.text_zh:
再动
每当你从放逐区使用攻击行动牌或“非攻击”行动牌时，若本回合你尚未使用过另一张该类型的牌，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
若你在你的回合期间失去生命，摧毁维度十字路口。
dimenxxional_crossroads.text_en:
Go again
Whenever you play an attack action card or a 'non-attack' action card from the banished zone, if you haven't played another card of that type this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.
If you lose {h} during your turn, destroy Dimenxxional Crossroads.

dimenxxional_gateway.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动
dimenxxional_gateway.text_zh:
占卜3
展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为符文剑士牌，对每位对手英雄造成1点奥术伤害。若其为暗影牌，你可以放逐它。
再动
dimenxxional_gateway.text_en:
Opt 3
Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Runeblade card, deal 1 arcane damage to each opposing hero. If it's a Shadow card, you may banish it.
Go again

doomsaying.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
doomsaying.text_zh:
再动
在你的结束阶段开始时，在此牌上放置一个末日指示物，然后每位英雄摧毁其控制的X个光环，X为此牌上的末日指示物数量。
doomsaying.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of your end phase, put a doom counter on this, then each hero destroys X auras they control, where X is the number of doom counters on this.

douse_in_runeblood.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
douse_in_runeblood.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，创造与你本回合使用过的非攻击行动牌数量相等的符文吟唱衍生物。若以此方式创造了3个或更多符文吟唱，此牌获得再动。
douse_in_runeblood.text_en: When this attacks, create Runechant tokens equal to the number of non-attack action cards you've played this turn. If 3 or more Runechants are created this way, this gets go again.

drawn_to_the_dark_dimension.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
drawn_to_the_dark_dimension.text_zh:
每当你控制一个符文吟唱，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
当此牌攻击时，抽一张牌。
drawn_to_the_dark_dimension.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.
When this attacks, draw a card.

dread_scythe.type_zh: 符文剑士 武器·Scythe （双手）
dread_scythe.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击
每当你用恐惧镰刀攻击时，对防御英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
被恐惧镰刀造成伤害的英雄在其下一个行动阶段期间不能获得生命。
dread_scythe.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack
Whenever you attack with Dread Scythe, deal 1 arcane damage to the defending hero.
A hero dealt damage by Dread Scythe can't gain {h} during their next action phase.

dread_triptych.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
dread_triptych.text_zh:
当你用恐惧三联画攻击时，若本回合你使用过一张“非攻击”行动牌，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
当你用恐惧三联画攻击时，若本回合你造成过奥术伤害，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
若恐惧三联画命中，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
dread_triptych.text_en:
When you attack with Dread Triptych, if you've played a 'non-attack' action card this turn, create a Runechant token.
When you attack with Dread Triptych, if you've dealt arcane damage this turn, create a Runechant token.
If Dread Triptych hits, create a Runechant token.

drowning_dire.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
drowning_dire.text_zh:
若本回合你使用过或创造过一个光环，淹没的恐惧获得支配。
当淹没的恐惧命中时，你可以将你坟场中的一张“非攻击”行动牌置于你的牌库底。
drowning_dire.text_en:
If you have played or created an aura this turn, Drowning Dire gains dominate.
When Drowning Dire hits, you may put a 'non-attack' action card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.

duskblade.text_zh:

sonata_arcanix.text_en:
Reveal the top X+3 cards of your deck.
For each non-attack action card revealed this way, put an attack action card revealed this way into your hand. Then deal arcane damage to target hero equal to the number of cards put into your hand this way. Shuffle, then banish this.
Go again

sonata_fantasmia.text_zh:
维塞莱专精
创造X个符文吟唱衍生物。
若X为6或更高，目标英雄随机弃3张牌。
sonata_fantasmia.text_en:
Viserai Specialization
Create X Runechant tokens.
If X is 6 or greater, target hero discards 3 random cards.

sonata_galaxia.text_zh:
每当你控制一个符文吟唱，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用为X或更低的符文剑士光环，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。
若X为2或更高，此牌获得再动。
sonata_galaxia.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.
Search your deck for a Runeblade aura with cost X or less, put it into the arena, then shuffle.
If X is 2 or more, this gets go again.

soul_shackle.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 衍生物·光环
soul_shackle.text_zh: 在你的行动阶段开始时，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。
soul_shackle.text_en: At the beginning of your action phase, banish the top card of your deck.

spellblade_assault.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
spellblade_assault.text_zh: 当你用咒刃突袭攻击时，创造2个符文吟唱衍生物。
spellblade_assault.text_en: When you attack with Spellblade Assault, create 2 Runechant tokens.

spellblade_strike.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
spellblade_strike.text_zh: 创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。

splintering_deadwood.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
splintering_deadwood.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或命中时，你可以摧毁你控制的一个光环。若如此做，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
splintering_deadwood.text_en: When this attacks or hits, you may destroy an aura you control. If you do, create a Runechant token.

star_fall.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 武器·剑 （双手）
star_fall.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
若本回合你使用过一张闪电牌，此牌的攻击获得+1力量和再动。
star_fall.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
If you've played a Lightning card this turn, this card's attacks get +1{p} and go again.

static_shock.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
static_shock.text_zh: 闪电流转——当此牌命中英雄时，若本回合你使用过一张闪电牌，对其造成1点奥术伤害。
static_shock.text_en: Lightning Flow - When this hits a hero, if you've played a Lightning card this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to them.

sting_of_sorcery.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
sting_of_sorcery.text_zh:
再动
你控制的攻击行动牌获得“当你用此牌攻击时，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。”
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁巫术之刺。
sting_of_sorcery.text_en:
Go again
Attack action cards you control gain "When you attack with this, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero."
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Sting of Sorcery.

stinging_sprite.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
stinging_sprite.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或防御时，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
stinging_sprite.text_en: When this attacks or defends, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

stir_the_wildwood.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
stir_the_wildwood.text_zh:
大地融合
若本回合你对对手英雄造成过奥术伤害，搅动野林获得+2力量。
若搅动野林已融合，它获得+2力量。
stir_the_wildwood.text_en:
Earth Fusion
If you have dealt arcane damage to an opposing hero this turn, Stir the Wildwood gains +2{p}.
If Stir the Wildwood was fused, it gains +2{p}.

stunning_swipe.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
stunning_swipe.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点奥术伤害。”
此牌第一次对闪电英雄造成伤害时，横置该英雄或其控制的一把武器。
stunning_swipe.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a Lightning hero, {t} them or a weapon they control.

succumb_to_temptation.text_zh:
若本回合你造成过奥术伤害，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
本回合你控制的符文剑士攻击行动牌下一次命中英雄时，查看其手牌并选择一张牌。该英雄弃掉它。
再动
succumb_to_temptation.text_en:
If you've dealt arcane damage this turn, you may play this as though it were an instant.
The next time a Runeblade attack action card you control hits a hero this turn, look at their hand and choose a card. They discard it.
Go again

sutcliffes_research_notes.name_zh: 萨特克利夫的研究笔记
sutcliffes_research_notes.text_zh:
展示你牌库顶的3张牌。每有一张以此方式展示的符文剑士攻击行动牌，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物，然后将这些牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。
再动
sutcliffes_research_notes.text_en:
Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Create a Runechant token for each Runeblade attack action card revealed this way, then put the cards on top of your deck in any order.
Go again

swarming_gloomveil.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
swarming_gloomveil.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过或创造过1个或更多光环，蜂拥的暗影面纱获得再动。若你使用过和/或创造过2个或更多，它获得+1力量。若你使用过和/或创造过3个或更多，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，本回合该英雄不能防止你控制的来源造成的奥术伤害。”
swarming_gloomveil.text_en: If you have played or created 1 or more auras this turn, Swarming Gloomveil gains go again. If you have played and/or created 2 or more, it gains +1{p}. If you have played and/or created 3 or more, it gains "When this hits a hero, they can't prevent arcane damage from sources you control this turn."

tempestuous_kiss.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
tempestuous_kiss.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点奥术伤害。”
此牌第一次对英雄造成伤害时，该英雄弃一张牌。
tempestuous_kiss.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p} and "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a hero, they discard a card.

thistle_bloom_life.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·大地 瞬间
thistle_bloom_life.text_zh:
凝合
创造X个符文吟唱衍生物，X为本回合你获得的生命总量。
//
获得1点生命。

tome_of_the_arknight.text_zh:
展示你牌库顶的2张牌。若以此方式展示的是一张攻击行动牌和一张非攻击行动牌，将它们置入你的手牌。
再动
tome_of_the_arknight.text_en:
Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. If you reveal an attack action card and a non-attack action card this way, put them into your hand.
Go again

unhallowed_rites.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
unhallowed_rites.text_zh:
若本回合你使用过一张“非攻击”行动牌，你可以从你的放逐区使用亵渎仪式。
你可以将你坟场中一张具有血债的“非攻击”行动牌置于你的牌库底。
血债
unhallowed_rites.text_en:
If you have played a 'non-attack' action card this turn, you may play Unhallowed Rites from your banished zone.
You may put a 'non-attack' action card with blood debt from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.
Blood Debt

vantage_point.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
vantage_point.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过或创造过一个光环，此牌获得压制。
vantage_point.text_en: If you've played or created an aura this turn, this gets overpower.

vantom_banshee.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击

vantom_wraith.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击

vaporize_shock.type_zh: 符文剑士 瞬间·闪电 Instant
vaporize_shock.text_zh:
凝合
摧毁一个费用为X或更低的光环永久物和/或至多X个光环衍生物，X为本回合你对对手英雄造成的奥术伤害总量。
//
对任意目标造成1点奥术伤害。
vaporize_shock.text_en:
Meld
Destroy an aura permanent with cost X or less and/or up to X aura tokens, where X is the total arcane damage you've dealt to opposing heroes this turn.
//
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

vela_flash.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动·攻击
vela_flash.text_zh:
闪电融合
若维拉闪光已融合，本回合你可以将你的下一张“非攻击”行动牌当作瞬间使用。
vela_flash.text_en:
Lightning Fusion
If Vela Flash was fused, you may play your next 'non-attack' action card this turn as though it were an instant.

verdant_tide.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 行动
verdant_tide.text_zh:
直到回合结束，若你将创造1个或更多元素或符文剑士光环衍生物，改为创造数量加1的每种这些衍生物。
大地羁绊——若你为使用此牌资源过一张大地牌，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
再动
verdant_tide.text_en:
Until end of turn, if you would create 1 or more Elemental or Runeblade aura tokens, instead create that many plus 1 of each of those tokens.
Earth Bond - If an Earth card was pitched to play this, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Go again

vexing_malice.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
vexing_malice.text_zh: 对目标英雄造成2点奥术伤害。
vexing_malice.text_en: Deal 2 arcane damage to target hero.

voltbound_duality.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
voltbound_duality.text_zh: 瞬间——支付1点资源，弃掉此牌：对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。创造一个闪电流转衍生物。
voltbound_duality.text_en: Instant - {r}, discard this: Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. Create a Lightning Flow token.

weeping_battleground.type_zh: 符文剑士 防御反应
weeping_battleground.text_zh: 你可以放逐你坟场中的一个光环。若如此做，对目标英雄造成1点奥术伤害。
weeping_battleground.text_en: You may banish an aura from your graveyard. If you do, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

widespread_annihilation.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
widespread_annihilation.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，本回合失去过生命的每位英雄放逐其手牌中的一张牌。
血债
widespread_annihilation.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, each hero who has lost {h} this turn banishes a card from their hand.
Blood Debt

widespread_destruction.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
widespread_destruction.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，本回合失去过生命的每位英雄放逐其军械库中的一张牌。
血债
widespread_destruction.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, each hero who has lost {h} this turn banishes a card from their arsenal.
Blood Debt

widespread_ruin.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
widespread_ruin.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，本回合失去过生命的每位英雄放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
血债
widespread_ruin.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, each hero who has lost {h} this turn banishes the top card of their deck.
Blood Debt

written_in_the_stars.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动
written_in_the_stars.text_zh:
创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
若本回合你造成过奥术伤害，抽一张牌。
written_in_the_stars.text_en:
Create an Embodiment of Lightning token.
If you've dealt arcane damage this turn, draw a card.
